Dear  Filipe,


I have worked on the stand count aspect by using the FIELDimageR package. That was really helpful for me. Now I am working on wheat ear count ortho mosaic, in this case how I can use the fieldCount function so we will get an ear count per row.?

I have attached the wheat ear orthomosaic for your reference.


Kindly suggest for the same.


Thank you,
Sudhir

messages.author: c59b667c61f258ae
messages.subject: Re: Regarding with Counting the number of Ear of wheat
parts:
Hi Sudhir,

 

Thanks for asking. The pipeline is basically the same...!

 

You need to segment the image with one index that allows better identification of the ears and removing leaves and soil. After that, you can draw the shapefile to count the number of identified ears per plot.

 

However, the current method for doing image segmentation in FIELDimageR is called thresholding. This method probably will not do a good job once that ear and leaves have similar colors. For that you need to develop a index to identify perfectly only the ears (it will required some investigation and time). Another solution is to use machine learning algorithms from other software, but for that is required training the models (annotate images). 

 

As soon as I have new features about counting ears I will post here and let you know.

 

Please, let us know if you find a good segmentation index or any other solution (e.g., which software/pipeline that you decided to use) ...!

 

All the best,

Filipe
